raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Refs #37419. Failed multimodal loads can include authenticated URLs or inline media in both the outer error and its chained traceback. Truncating the input still exposes credentials and payload prefixes.

## Modifications

```diff
 _load_single_item
-  include raw input and chain the original loader exception
+  describe the input without its contents
+  redact URLs and inline media throughout the exception chain
+  preserve client ValueError versus server RuntimeError classification
```

The registered CPU regression covers malformed URLs, authenticated ImageData URLs and inline data URIs. This update merges current main, satisfies the current MIN_BASE_SHA, and removes one parser-version-specific diagnostic assertion while retaining the privacy and exception-type assertions. Existing image decoding and video device selection remain unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

On Apple Silicon, using the documented `pyproject_other.toml` / `all_mps` installation and the normal package initializer:

- Before the fix on current main: the 10 original bad-input tests passed, while three additional privacy reproductions exposed request media in formatted exceptions.
- After integration: 13 bad-input tests and 10 original image-decoding tests passed.
- A separate CPU harness used the real BaseMultimodalProcessor constructor, production task submission and ThreadPoolExecutor/Future path: nested client-error redaction, malformed URL redaction and valid PNG eager decoding passed.
- Changed executable line coverage: 47/57 (82.46%) against current main. Coverage started after normal imports because instrumenting package startup crashed on this environment; unmeasured declaration lines remain counted as uncovered.
- `pre-commit run --all-files` passed, including Rust formatting and clippy.

No model inference, GPU accuracy/performance run or hosted CI pass is claimed. Two initial coverage startup crashes and one explicit media-config fixture correction are retained in the local validation record.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run: this changes error reporting rather than model forward execution or the successful loading path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add registered unit regressions and run relevant current tests.
- [ ] Update documentation (no new configuration or public API).
- [ ] Provide model accuracy and speed benchmarks (not applicable to this error-reporting change).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way. The Python-only redaction change can be reverted independently.

**Blast Radius:** Errors. Diagnostic text intentionally hides request media; callers retain client/server exception classification and sanitized chained causes.

 _is_npu = is_npu()
 _is_xpu = is_xpu()
 
+_DATA_URI_PATTERN = re.compile(r"data:[^,\s]*,[^\s'\"<>]+", re.IGNORECASE)
+_MEDIA_URL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?:https?|file)://[^\s'\"<>]+", re.IGNORECASE)
+_MIME_TYPE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.+-]*/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.+-]*")
+
+
+def _describe_media_input(data) -> str:
+    if isinstance(data, (ImageData, VideoData)):
+        data = data.url
+    if isinstance(data, str):
+        if data.startswith("data:"):
+            metadata, separator, payload = data.partition(",")
+            mime_type = metadata[5:].split(";", 1)[0].lower()
+            if not _MIME_TYPE_PATTERN.fullmatch(mime_type):
+                mime_type = "unknown"
+            encoded_length = len(payload) if separator else 0
+            return f"<data-uri mime={mime_type} encoded_length={encoded_length}>"
+        if data.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+            scheme = data.partition(":")[0].lower()
+            return f"<url scheme={scheme}>"
+        if data.startswith("file://"):
+            return "<file-uri>"
+        return f"<string length={len(data)}>"
+    if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
+        return f"<bytes length={len(data)}>"
+    if isinstance(data, Image.Image):
+        return f"<image mode={data.mode} size={data.width}x{data.height}>"
+    return f"<{type(data).__name__}>"
+
+
+def _redact_media_text(text: str, data) -> str:
+    descriptor = _describe_media_input(data)
+    raw_values = {str(data), repr(data)}
+    if isinstance(data, (ImageData, VideoData)):
+        raw_values.update((data.url, repr(data.url)))
+    for raw_value in sorted(raw_values, key=len, reverse=True):
+        if raw_value:
+            text = text.replace(raw_value, descriptor)
+    text = _DATA_URI_PATTERN.sub("<data-uri>", text)
+    return _MEDIA_URL_PATTERN.sub("<url>", text)
+
+
+def _sanitize_media_exception(error: Exception, data) -> Exception:
+    message = _redact_media_text(str(error), data)
+    try:
+        sanitized = type(error)(message)
+    except Exception:
+        sanitized = RuntimeError(f"{type(error).__name__}: {message}")
+    if error.__cause__ is not None:
+        sanitized.__cause__ = _sanitize_media_exception(error.__cause__, data)
+    elif error.__context__ is not None:
+        sanitized.__context__ = _sanitize_media_exception(error.__context__, data)
+    sanitized.__suppress_context__ = error.__suppress_context__
+    return sanitized
+

+class TestBadInputDoesNotLeakMedia(CustomTestCase):
+    """Loader failures must not expose request media in formatted exceptions."""
+
+    def test_malformed_url_preserves_sanitized_client_error(self):
+        url = "https://[invalid"
